recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding an external hosted heartbeat (dead-man's-switch) monitor such as Healthchecks.io for `nightly-sync`, pinged by a cron wrapper, then testing that both a failed run and a missing run send an alert.
note: The reply recommends one external heartbeat alert, mentions self-hosted Healthchecks only as an option, and puts off Docker and central logging until there is a concrete need, but it has none of the four labelled record lines.
